question: Which of the following dance forms emotes a play through dancing in which the song is customarily in Manipravala language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniattam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mohiniattam** is a classical dance form of Kerala, India, known for its graceful movements and emotive storytelling.
 
• The songs performed in Mohiniattam are traditionally composed in the **Manipravala language**, which is a mix of Malayalam and Sanskrit.
 
• This dance form primarily depicts themes of love and devotion, often based on stories from Hindu mythology.
 
• Mohiniattam is characterized by slow, rhythmic movements and unique costumes featuring white sarees with golden borders.
 
• The term "Mohiniattam" translates to "dance of the enchantress," referring to Mohini, a mythical avatar of Lord Vishnu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipravala Language:** A blend of Malayalam and Sanskrit, commonly used in classical literature and dance compositions in Kerala.
 
• **Classical Dance Forms of India:** India has eight classical dance forms recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, including Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Mohiniattam, Sattriya, and Manipuri.
 
• **Kerala's Cultural Heritage:** Kerala is renowned for its rich traditions in classical dance, music, and theater, with Mohiniattam being a significant part of its artistic legacy.
 
• **Costume and Jewelry:** Mohiniattam dancers wear traditional white attire with golden borders, along with elegant jewelry and floral hair adornments.
 
• **Training and Performance:** Mohiniattam requires years of rigorous training in classical music, dance techniques, and expressive gestures (Abhinaya) to master its nuances.
